newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho considers JCI merger proposal.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho considers JCI merger proposal.

text.p: The board of Lonrho Plc is meeting on Tuesday to discuss the two billion pound merger proposal from South Africa's JCI Ltd.
But Lonrho would not say whether a company announcement was imminent later today. "There isn't really an expectation," a spokesman said.
The board meeting comes after Lonrho and JCI last week confirmed they had held talks on a possible link-up.
Newspapers here reported that mining-to-hotels conglomerate Lonrho wants a 60 percent stake in any new entity. But JCI is believed to accept a Lonrho interest of only little more than 50 percent.
Industry watchers said the merger proposal has the strong backing of Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd, which owns 27.5 percent of Lonrho.
A merger could allow Anglo a way out of Lonrho, after the European Commission forced it last month to trim its stake to 9.99 percent, analysts said.
Anglo's share in Lonrho could be cancelled in return for the UK company's minority holding in Ghana's Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd as part of a link-up, they added.
But besides JCI, Avmin Ltd and Gencor Ltd were also interested in tying up with Lonrho, South Africa's Business Day newspaper said last week.
